en: You have not learned any new Emotions
de: Du hast keine neuen Emotionen Freigeschaltet

en: You are currently trying to quit this awesome and super interesting game that you have right in front of you, are you sure that you REALLY REALLY want to leave us all alone??
de: Du versuchst gerade dieses wunderschöne und superinteressante Spiel vor dir zu Verlassen, bist du dir WIRKLICH sicher das du uns alleine lassen willst?

en: You don't really feel like getting up...
Time to get up! Another day again. Another day of work...
de: Zeit aufzustehen. Schon wieder Morgen. Schon wieder Arbeit...

en: You crawl out of bed and get ready for work.
de: Du schälst dich aus dem Bett und machst dich fertig für die Arbeit.

en: You have the feeling maybe your phone rang at some point...
de: Dumpf hast du das Gefühl, dein Telefon hat irgendwann geklingelt...
Du nimmst deine Jacke und gehst.

en: This thing stops working as soon as you need it. It's been like this so long you forget what it's like not to have to argue with your office supplies.
de: Das Teil klappt nie, wenn du es brauchst. Das geht schon so lange so, dass du dich nicht erinnerst, dass im Büro irgendwann mal alles funktioniert hätte.
Der Drucker klappt immer noch nicht.

en: You actually have work to do. Someone else can take care of this if they want to.
de: Du hast tatsächlich Tasks abzuarbeiten. Um den Drucker kann sich jemand anderes kümmern.

en: You check the error message and do a quick search for causes.
de: Du liest dir die Fehlernachricht durch und suchst nach der Nummer im Internet.

en: It takes a relative age. When it's done running updates, the printer starts working down the list of documents in queue.
de: Es dauert eine gefühlte Ewigkeit. Wenn die Updates alle durch sind, fängt der Drucker an, die Queue an offenen Aufträgen auszudrucken.

en: You can't believe no one thought to do this before.
de: Du kannst nicht glauben, dass das echt noch niemand versucht hat.

en: Apparently your coworkers can't either. There's an embarrassed silence while everyone looks on as the printer busily works away.
de: Deine Kollegen können es scheinbar auch nicht glauben. Betretendes Schweigen ersetzt die übliche Geräuschkulisse während alle dem Drucker beim Drucken zuschauen.

en: Then, there's a bit of a stir as people get to cancelling old tickets and the usual office noises start back up again.
de: Dann geht ein Raunen durch den Raum und deine Kollegen stornieren offenkundig alte, verloren geglaubte Druckaufträge.

en: This printer is a reflection of the poor state of your inner world.
de: Dieser Drucker ist ein Sinnbild für dein Innerstes.
Schlag mit der Faust gegen den Drucker.

en: Where do you think you are going!
And don't think you can come back!
de: Und glauben Sie nicht, dass Sie noch einmal wieder kommen brauchen!

en: I might be late if I getcoffee. Should I do it?
de: Ich könnte mir einen Kaffee holen, aber dann komme ich vielleicht zu spät...

en: You enter the store to get a nice, hot, delicious cup of coffee to go.
de: Du betrittst den Laden um dir eine guten, heißen, leckeren Kaffee to go zu kaufen.

en: The machine roars to life and starts to prepare a perfect cup of black gold.
de: Die Maschine erwacht laut brodelnd zum Leben um mit der Produktion eines Bechers schwarzen Goldes  zu beginnen.

en: Meh. Better then nothing i guess.
de: Meh. Naja, besser als gar nichts.

en: At first the machine produces small droplets. Then they swell to a steady stream of steaming coffee.
de: Zuerst tröpfelt der Kaffee nur langsam aus der Maschine. Dann wächst er zu einem stetigen Fluss dampfender, heißer Flüssigkeit.

en:
The machine sprays out the last cloud of aromatic vapours and returns to its motionles dead state.
The coffee in the cup shimmers like a calm, dark pond in the middle of a forest.
Pure ecstasy.
de:
Die Maschine spuckt die letzten duftenden Wölkchen aus und kehrt zu ihrem toten Ruhezustand zurück.
Der Kaffee im Becher spiegelt das kühle Licht des Ladens, wie ein ruhiger, dunkler Teich inmitten eines Waldes. Die reine Ekstase.

en: One coffee is enough for now. I should hurry to work.
de: Ein Kaffee reicht erst mal. Ich sollte mich beeilen.

en: I should just head to work.
de: Ich sollte besser gleich zur Arbeit.

en: Good morning! Cutting it a bit close, aren't we?
Well don't just stand there gawking!
This has got to stop! And you have got to step up!
One more thing like that and you don't need to come back at all!
An old lady blocks your way. The sidewalk isn't wide enough for you to pass her.
de: Eine alte Frau blockiert den Weg. Der Fußgängerweg ist nicht breit genug, um an ihr vorbei zu gehen.

en:
Large bags are lying on the floor, food and other groceries strewn everywhere.
A massacre of produce.
de: Große Tüten liegen auf dem Boden, Essen und andere Einkäufe überall verteilt.

en: Really. What should I do now?
de: Echt jetzt? Was mach ich denn jetzt?
Es fühlt sich wie eine Ewigkeit an....

en: You push her to the side as you pass her
de: Du schubst sie beiseite und quetschst dich vorbei.

en: Out of my way, old hag!
Oh, that is very kind of you!
de: Ach, das ist aber nett von Ihnen!

en: You pick up her items on the floor and put them back in the bags.
de: Du sammelst ihre Einkäufe vom Boden ein und verteilst sie in ihre Taschen.

en: You are such a nice, young person. A gentleman! Such a pleasant surprise nowadays.
de: Sie sind aber ein netter, junger Mann. Ein richtiger Gentleman! Was für eine nette Überraschung heutzutage.

en: Not at all. Happy to help.
Sorry to have kept you. Oh, if I was just ten years younger....
de: Es tut mir Leid, Sie aufgehalten zu haben. Ach, wenn ich nur zehn Jahre jünger wäre....
Dann fängt sie an zu weinen.

en: Big tears roll from her eyes. Sobbing and crying in the middle of her bags and groceries.
de: Fette Tränen laufen ihr über die Wangen. Weinend und kreischend sitzt sie zwischen ihren Einkäufen auf dem Boden.

en: You walk on in a hurry, stress levels rising.
de: Du beeilst dich und merkst trotzdem, wie dein Stress zunimmt.

en: Nothing you can do other than wait.
de: Du kannst nichts tun außer warten.

en: Your desk looks as uninspiring as always.
You power up your work computer.
You knew you should have gotten a coffee. You're not able to concentrate at all.
You may do mediocre work today, but you don't feel like getting up...
Stay standing in front of your desk.
You continue where you left off the previous day.
You stare at the screen, unable to concentrate.
Go to the office kitchen for coffee.
Please go stand at your own desk.
You stare at him until he looks at you.
You stare at each other awkwardly.
Your colleague looks taken aback for a moment, then he turns away from you.
A dog is lying on the ground in front of the supermarket.
You ignore the dog. So does the dog.
You wonder why this dog sits here.
No sight of anyone caring for the dog.
It may have been a long time since someone realy noticed the poor thing.
It sits here day in day out. Is it waiting for something?
You slowly get closer to the dog. Finaly you put forth you hand and offer your empty hand to the dog.
The dog looks at you hand. After some hesitation, it sniffs your hand.
Did you finish your report? I want it tomorrow morning on my desk!
I'm not paying you to chit-chat!
Is that attitude you're giving me?
I fixed that problem we've been having with the printer.
You are not putting in the work I expect of you. You keep coming in late and your work mentality lately is abysmal!
Show some spite! Put in some effort!
If you allow yourself one more plunder, that's it!
Now that's more like it. Keep it up!
Oh, I've had it with you!
Pack your things and get your sorry self out of my sight!
Now get to work on that report!
Well, good job! About time you showed some initiative!
Do you have any idea how much work I'm putting in?
Just getting to work each day takes some real effort of will with how boring and tedious this job is!
Maybe you're the one who needs to change, not me!
You're just getting started, but your boss doesn't let you finish.
Why, never in all my days have I had to endure such disrespect!
Get your sorry self out of my sight!
And don't think you need to come back! You're fired!

The coffee mashine looks like a christmas tree.
Lights blinking constantly.
Realy? Someone has to do something about this!
Nothing I can do about it. Hopefully someone will fix it.
You take your phone and call the support hotline.
The callcenter supporter never had a chance..
You scream into your phone. Anger burning in your heart.
After some time you let it all out. The flames boil down.
On the other end of the line is just silence.
You end the call and return to more important matters.
Calmly you explain the problem with the mashine to the support.
Together you identify the problem. The support manager gives you detailed instructions of what to do.
after some minutes of tinkering witht he mashine it roars to life and starts the cleaning process.
You did it! What a relief!
In the end you get your coffee.
A warm feeling of being helpfull stirs inside you.
You anger stirs up again just by seeing the blinking lights.

Nothing has changed. What did you expect.
No one cared. Not even you..
Finaly. The darm mashine was fixed!
Reluctantly the mashine gobbles up a coffee into your mug.
The smell is not as good as it used to.
The company just showed up and did something before leaving without a word.
He looks down on his coffee.
Don't know if i prefer not having coffee at all..

You kick the mashine.
How does it dare to give you such a bad coffee.

Strangely the christmal lights lit up again..
You broke the mashine.
It may not be safe to drink that.
You dispose the coffee in the sink.
I will not get another coffe.
The colleague is surrounded by others hwo are making fun of him.
You are used to this view. The colleague is just so easy to make fun of.
I should better not be involved in this.
What if they pick on me next?
You move on. Too afraid to step up.
Out of nowhere you join in.
You are part of the mob now. You feel that you belong here.
We can see tears in the eyes of the colleague.
We continue. Fuled by the reaction of the colleague.
We are one. Against one. That is fair.
Thats it! I cant take it anymore!
He storms of. We have won.
But all good things come to an end.
After a short quiet time we disband.
The mob continues the barages of hurtfull comments.

You'r voice rips through the room.
All eyes are on you. In shock? With hope?
Will you just leave it be? He's had enouth of your behaviour and so do I!
You are just a bunch of hatefull people with nothing better to do than to pick on him!
The mob tries to hold against you. But you overwelm them easily.
The mob is one, but you and your colleague are two.
After a short quiet time the mob disbands.
I hope this will not backfire.
But if feels good right now.
Thank you again for stepping up.
Your bed looks very inviting. It's your favorite piece of furniture.
Thanks for your hard work always.
It's really convenient you always come by this store on your way home.
You get your stuff and queue up. This store's always busy around this time.
You can hear her crying, but you keep walking.
You play with her for a bit.
Bye bye mister! Let's play again!
Where are your mom and dad, kid?
The smile slips off the child's face.
You don't know what to do.
You try to calm her down, but it's not really working
The passersby are looking at you....
You can hear someone else start talking to the child. They are surely much better equipped to deal with this than you are.
You call the police and explain the situation.
The parents have already filed a report and are quickly found.
You wait with the child who has calmed down a bit by now.
Your mom will be here son, kid.
Finally a car turns into the parking lot, wheels screeching.
A woman comes tumbling out and rushes towards you.
The child starts crying again as they hug.
'Thank you for contacting the police and helping us find our baby!'
You talk for a bit and exchange numbers before saying goodbye. The child is half asleep in her mother's arms.
Bye kid. Keep close to your parents from now on, yeah?
Uhuh. Bye mister, let's play again...
You wonder why she's here alone...
